review:
Big Bass Xmas Extreme takes the fisherman to Antarctica, complete with penguins and rucksacks. Three scatters trigger 10 free spins, and two scatters on the top rows award a respin for another chance to complete the trigger.

Before the bonus starts, you open Christmas gifts that award modifiers: extra spins, assured cash symbols, fishermen already collected, or removal of the lowest cash value. During free spins, each fisherman collects all cash on the reels, and every fourth one adds 10 more spins and a multiplier that can reach 50x. A random waterfall feature can also flood the reels with cash prizes. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win. The 50x top multiplier sets this apart from most of the series.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
